description: This is a test class for the UserRoleManagerHelper in the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing authorization permission helpers related to user roles and employee data. It verifies behaviors like permission retrieval, self-identification, and permission collection for employee data.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerHelperTest
classes.description: Test suite for the UserRoleManagerHelper class, covering permission retrieval, self-identity checks, and permission collection logic.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeWithoutAssignedEmployee
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval for an employee without an assigned employee record.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeWithAssignedEmployee
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval when the employee is directly assigned to the user.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeForSelfPermission
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval with self-permission context enabled.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionsForEmployeeForNotSelfPermission
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval with self-permission context disabled.

methods.name: testGetDataGroupPermissionCollectionForEmployee
methods.description: Tests obtaining a permission collection for an employee's data group permissions.

methods.name: getIsSelfByEmpNumber
methods.description: Data-driven test to verify if the current user is identified as 'self' based on employee number.
